thread:
Maria S.: FYI Greenleaf (invoice inv_GL_2025_007) is 45 days overdue — outstanding $28,400. ACH attempted 3x, all failed. Customer emailed saying temporary cashflow hit and asked if we can do a payment plan. cc @Jason L.
Jason L.: Can you paste the invoice and the dunning history?
Maria S.: invoice link: https://redwood.billing/invoices/inv_GL_2025_007.pdf
Maria S.: Dunning log: CollectionsBot attempted ACH 2026-02-18, 2026-02-25, 2026-03-03 — all returned R01 (insufficient funds). Last reminder email sent 2026-03-05.
CollectionsBot: [automated] Payment attempts: 3 failures. Last failure code: R01. Next scheduled reminder: 2026-03-12.
Erin P.: CS spoke with their finance lead (Tom L.). He says they expect a cash infusion mid-April and asked for a 3-4 month plan. Wants no interest, just schedule.
Jason L.: Okay. Do we want to escalate to our collections vendor or try an internal plan first? If they sign an agreement + we get first tranche, I prefer internal to keep the account.
Maria S.: Agreed. Proposed: 4 equal installments of $7,100. First payment due immediately on signed ACH authorization or card, then monthly on the 15th for the next 3 months. No fees. If they miss 2 consecutive payments -> hand over to Collections.
Erin P.: I'll confirm with Tom that 4x is acceptable. If they can only do 3 payments, we can make the first payment larger.
Jason L.: Need approval from finance director to lock this in. @Maria S. can you draft a payment plan doc we can send for signature and include an ACH/Credit authorization?
Maria S.: Drafting now. Will include clause: missed payment = 7-day grace, then late notice; 2 missed payments -> collections. Will attach the signed schedule to the invoice record.
Jason L.: Fine as long as we require a valid payment method on file or an immediate first payment. Also, capture PII protocol — do not paste full bank details in thread.
Maria S.: Understood. I'll send secure link. Plan to send payment request today.
Erin P.: If they push for no upfront, ask for a CC hold for the full amount as backup.
Maria S.: Good call. I'll ask CS to request a card token or signed ACH.
CollectionsBot: [automated] Note added to account GL-0007: Proposed 4-month payment plan pending customer signature. Escalate to vendor if > 60 days overdue after plan offered.
Jason L.: Approved on my end to offer the 4-month plan with the terms above. @Erin P. please get verbal confirmation and cc me when you send the agreement.
Erin P.: Will do. I’ll update once Tom signs or responds with counterproposal. :thumbsup:
Maria S.: Sending secure agreement link now. Link (mask): https://pay.redwood/secure/plan/XXXXXXXX
Erin P.: Customer asked whether we can reduce to 3 payments. If they insist, we can propose: $10,000 now, $9,200 next, $9,200 final (total $28,400). Is that acceptable?
Jason L.: 3-pay looks fine if CS can get initial $10k today. If not, keep 4x. Document whichever they sign.
Maria S.: Noted. I’ll include both templates (3-pay and 4-pay) in the doc to speed signing.
Erin P.: Update: Tom is sending initial $10k via ACH today and will sign the 3-pay draft. He asked for invoice to be marked as "in good standing" while on plan.
Jason L.: Marking note: do not remove overdue flag until first payment clears. Also set internal reminder 3 days after planned payment for confirmation.
Maria S.: Done — created follow-up task and will confirm clearance with CollectionsBot.
CollectionsBot: [automated] Follow-up created: verify payment clearance for inv_GL_2025_007 on 2026-03-13.
Maria S.: I'll post the signed agreement and payment confirmation here once received. Thanks team. :pray:
Erin P.: Thanks all. I'll ping if anything changes.
